validation_environment: Local headless Chromium against isolated synthetic demo API
scope: Observed browser behavior only. No iOS/Android device, carrier, real vendor settlement/delivery, native-listener quality or production capacity qualification.
checks: Live capability is authoritative and no microphone starts before explicit call action
Real LiveKit JavaScript client connects and publishes the explicitly requested microphone
Trusted live agent data renders an actual synthetic speech transcript
Caller can mute the live microphone
Disconnect releases microphone tracks and returns to the typed fallback
accuracy_claim: Live transport and trusted data rendering only; no speech-recognition accuracy claim.
